user_request: Explain the buying and adoption system for this partner-referred repair marketplace, including where handoffs can fail and what must be established before promises are made.

trusted_context.authority: Analyze only. Do not contact participants, assign jobs, change agreements, or confirm appointments.

source_records.text: A property-management partner forwarded four tenant repair requests. Tenants need repairs but landlords must approve charges. Two landlords have not responded.
Providers have two available slots. They accept only after seeing job scope and access arrangements. A tenant submitting a request does not reserve a slot.

The partner earns a referral fee only after completed work. Platform support currently coordinates approvals manually. The draft welcome note calls every referral a confirmed booking; no handoff owner is named.
